# `captions.json`

**Generated by:** `scripts/transcribe.ts public/projects/<slug>/audio.wav` (Whisper.cpp, `medium.en`, word-level timestamps, via `@remotion/install-whisper-cpp`)
**Consumed by:** `CaptionOverlay` (`src/components/text/CaptionOverlay.tsx`), `useTranscription` (`src/hooks/useCaptions.ts`)

Word-level transcription, converted from Whisper's raw output to
`@remotion/captions`'s `Caption[]` shape via `toCaptions()`.

```json
[
  {"text": " Hello", "startMs": 0, "endMs": 340, "timestampMs": 170, "confidence": null},
  {"text": " world", "startMs": 340, "endMs": 720, "timestampMs": 530, "confidence": null}
]
```

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | one word/token (often with a leading space — Whisper token convention) |
| `startMs` / `endMs` | `number` | milliseconds into the audio |
| `timestampMs` | `number \| null` | Whisper's raw token timestamp, if provided |
| `confidence` | `number \| null` | not populated by this pipeline (always `null`) |

`CaptionOverlay`'s `combineTokensWithinMs` (default `1200`) groups adjacent
tokens into on-screen caption lines/pages; `offsetMs` shifts all timestamps,
used when a composition renders a trimmed sub-range of the source audio.
